caption:
i felt guilty every morning i didn't wake up at 5.

then i actually looked into it.

are you a morning person or a night person? 👇

slides.text:
every successful person wakes up at 5am
right?
slides.image: alarm list sheets waking up early

slides.query: does waking up early make you more successful
slides.result: Research hasn't shown that waking early **causes success.** Whether you're a morning or night person is partly in your genes.
slides.source: Jones et al., Nature Communications (2019), 697,828 people
slides.image: moon through bare branches dark night

slides.text:
so the 5am club might just be
people who were already morning people
slides.image: street lamp foggy road night run

slides.text:
the routine was never the secret
showing up was
slides.image: barbell in shaft of light discipline focus

slides.text:
find the hours where you're actually you
and protect them

send this to the friend
who feels guilty for sleeping in
